fusions.name: Ankle Nip
fusions.desc: A quick nip that deals 5 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Hamstring Snap
fusions.desc: A bite to the hamstring that deals 26 damage, ignores resistances, makes the target [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds and leaves it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Slip Behind
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack.

fusions.name: Edge Remembered
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds.
